title: Coproducts for the derived closed right adjoint
statement: Let C be a finite commutative ring, k an algebraically closed field, and f : X → Spec k a finite-type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For a closed immersion g : Z → X [def-weil-closed-immersion], the canonical right adjoint [lem-exc-closed-ambient] of the ordinary unbounded derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] on C-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] preserves coproducts indexed by every type in the chosen indexing universe, including the empty family.

source.place: Section 6.4, Lemma 6.4.4 and the last paragraph of Proposition 6.4.8, printed pp. 48–49; closed-support argument in step 4 of lem-pur-etale-lisse-stratum-compact.

proof.text: Establish that the canonical open complement is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and apply finite-type separably-closed étale cohomological dimension to its derived direct image.

Use the natural closed-support distinguished triangles and the fully proved generic triangleCoproducts and preservesCoproducts_of_triangle helpers. The first helper constructs coproducts of distinguished triangles by the opposite of productTriangle; the second compares that coproduct with the triangle of the coproduct object. The identity and complementary-open components are invertible, so the closed-support component is invertible by the triangulated two-out-of-three lemma.
The identity and complementary-open terms are isomorphisms; the first term is therefore an isomorphism, and full faithfulness of closed direct image reflects this to the right-adjoint comparison.
